title: Add more ArchUnit checks to architecture scanner
body:
## What does this PR do?

Adds four new curated ArchUnit rules to the architecture scanner to enforce standard Spring Boot and Java coding practices.

## Why is this change needed?

The Architecture panel can provide more value by proposing additional common architectural and coding checks. This PR introduces the following rules:
- `ServicesShouldNotDependOnControllersRule` (`ARCH-SPRING-006`): Enforces layering by prohibiting `@Service` beans from depending on `@Controller` or `@RestController` classes.
- `ExceptionsShouldBeNamedExceptionRule` (`ARCH-CODE-010`): Ensures classes extending `Exception` or `RuntimeException` are named with an "Exception" suffix.
- `InterfacesShouldNotHaveInterfaceSuffixRule` (`ARCH-CODE-011`): Checks that interfaces do not needlessly have "Interface" at the end of their name.
- `LoggersShouldBePrivateStaticFinalRule` (`ARCH-CODE-012`): Requires `org.slf4j.Logger` and `java.util.logging.Logger` fields to be `private static final`.

- [x] `./mvnw clean install` passes locally
- [x] Started `bootui-sample-app` and verified `/bootui` loads and the change works end-to-end
